newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania agency to sell Arctic to EBRD.
newsitem.headline: Romania agency to sell Arctic to EBRD.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development is expected to buy 51 percent in Romanian listed refrigerator maker Arctic before the end of the month, a government agency said on Thursday.
"We hope to complete our direct negotiations with the EBRD and sell off the stake in 20 days," Sorin Dimitriu, president of the State Ownership Fund (FPS), told a news conference.
The FPS, which is subordinated to the government, has a controlling stake in most Romanian state enterprises.
Dimitriu declined to give details of the deal, but said the FPS was not asking for a per-share price much higher than Arctic's market price.
EBRD officials said they had no immediate comment.
Arctic, a first-tier listing suspended from trading for 20 days in mid-June to avoid speculation due to selloff procedures, closed at 2,800 lei when it last traded on June 17.
Arctic has a share capital of around 57.2 billion lei, in shares with a nominal value of 1,000 lei each. The FPS has 50.99 percent of Arctic.
Dimitriu also said the FPS had dismissed on Thursday Artic's general manager over alleged management irregularities, which he said had cost the company around six million marks in losses.
"The company's marketing manager was appointed general manager for the time being," Dimitriu said. "Artic's new majority owners will appoint a new manager if they want."
"Our move was intended to avoid compromising the privatisation process," he added. "I don't think the current situation of Arctic will affect our talks with the EBRD." ($=7,079 lei)
